entries.meaningZh: 章（chapter 的书面缩写）
entries.en: For instructions on replacing the battery, see ch. 4 of the manual.
entries.zh: 更换电池的说明请参阅手册第四章。

entries.meaningZh: 章（chapter 的书面缩写）
entries.en: The answer key for chap. 6 is printed on a separate sheet.
entries.zh: 第六章的参考答案印在另一张纸上。

entries.meaningZh: 以及其他人；等人（用于列举姓名）
entries.en: The report by Chen et al. compares bus routes in three small towns.
entries.zh: 陈及其他人撰写的报告比较了三个小镇的公交线路。

entries.meaningZh: 说不定；也许（表示自己并不确知）
entries.en: For all I know, the spare key is still in the drawer at my old flat.
entries.zh: 说不定备用钥匙还在我以前那套公寓的抽屉里。

entries.meaningZh: 哼；嗯（本例表示思索、迟疑）
entries.en: H'm, that shelf may be too narrow for the larger boxes.
entries.zh: 嗯，那个架子可能太窄，放不下较大的箱子。

entries.meaningZh: 是不是；对不对（英式非标准口语附加问句）
entries.en: It's cold in here, innit? Shall I close the window?
entries.zh: 这里挺冷的，是不是？要不我把窗户关上？

entries.meaningZh: 与其说……不如说……
entries.en: Her reply was not so much angry as disappointed.
entries.zh: 她的回答与其说是生气，不如说是失望。

entries.meaningZh: 甚至可以说；即使不说是……（用更强的说法加强前面的判断）
entries.en: Leaving the borrowed camera on the wall was careless, not to say reckless.
entries.zh: 把借来的相机放在墙头上很不小心，甚至可以说是鲁莽。

entries.meaningZh: 犹特人；北美犹特原住民族群的一员
entries.en: Our guide, a Ute, explained why the site mattered to his community.
entries.zh: 我们的向导是一位犹特人，他解释了这处遗址对他的社群为何重要。

entries.meaningZh: 上午；午前（与钟点连用）
entries.en: The bakery opens at 6 a.m., before most of the neighbouring shops.
entries.zh: 这家面包店早上六点开门，比邻近的大多数商店都早。

entries.meaningZh: 下午；午后（与钟点连用）
entries.en: Please return the key by 5 P.M. so the caretaker can lock up.
entries.zh: 请在下午五点之前归还钥匙，好让管理员锁门。

entries.meaningZh: 即使不算是 A，至少也是 B；用较弱的判断修正较强的判断
entries.en: If the silence was not hostile, then it was certainly unfriendly.
entries.zh: 那阵沉默即使算不上充满敌意，也肯定不友好。

entries.meaningZh: 这样没有什么不对；这样可以接受
entries.en: When I asked whether I could wear trainers to work, my manager said, 'There's nothing wrong with it.'
entries.zh: 我问上班能不能穿运动鞋时，经理说：这样没什么不妥。

entries.term: This above all: to thine own self be true.
entries.meaningZh: 最重要的是忠于自己；坚守本心（莎士比亚《哈姆雷特》中的话）
entries.en: On the first page of her journal, Maya copied a line from Hamlet: 'This above all: to thine own self be true.'
entries.zh: 玛雅在日记第一页抄下了《哈姆雷特》中的一句话：最重要的是忠于自己。

entries.term: What have we got to lose?
entries.meaningZh: 试试又能损失什么呢？（表示尝试的风险或代价很小）
entries.en: 'What have we got to lose?' Nina asked, pointing to the free trial on the noticeboard.
entries.zh: 妮娜指着布告栏上的免费试用信息问：试试又能损失什么呢？

entries.meaningZh: 乙基的化学缩写符号
entries.en: In her diagram, one Et group was attached to the nitrogen atom.
entries.zh: 在她的示意图中，一个乙基连接在氮原子上。

entries.meaningZh: 铁；化学元素符号 Fe
entries.en: The students compared the amount of Fe in soil samples from two fields.
entries.zh: 学生们比较了两块田地的土壤样品中的铁含量。

entries.meaningZh: 指令集体系结构
entries.en: The engineers chose an ISA that supported the instructions their compiler needed.
entries.zh: 工程师们选择了一种能够支持其编译器所需指令的指令集体系结构。

entries.meaningZh: 信用证
entries.en: The exporter waited for the bank to issue the LC before loading the goods.
entries.zh: 出口商等银行开出信用证后才装货。

entries.meaningZh: 气相色谱法；气相层析法
entries.en: The laboratory used GC to separate the volatile compounds in the sample.
entries.zh: 实验室用气相色谱法分离样品中的挥发性化合物。

entries.meaningZh: 婆罗双树；娑罗树（Shorea robusta）
entries.en: Several sal trees shaded the narrow path through the forest.
entries.zh: 几棵娑罗树为穿过森林的狭窄小径遮荫。

entries.meaningZh: 脱氧鸟苷
entries.en: The lab ordered a fresh supply of dG for the next set of experiments.
entries.zh: 实验室为下一组实验新订购了一批脱氧鸟苷。

entries.meaningZh: 三磷酸腺苷
entries.en: The researchers measured how much ATP remained in the stored cells.
entries.zh: 研究人员测量了储存的细胞中剩余的三磷酸腺苷含量。

entries.meaningZh: 英斗；英制蒲式耳（容量单位的缩写）
entries.en: The British farm's old ledger records a delivery of 12 bu of oats.
entries.zh: 这座英国农场的旧账簿记载了一批十二英斗的燕麦。

entries.meaningZh: 数据电路终端设备；数据通信设备
entries.en: The technician checked the DCE before testing the cable to the terminal.
entries.zh: 技术员在测试通往终端的电缆之前，先检查了数据电路终端设备。

entries.meaningZh: 月（month 的书面缩写）
entries.en: Her rent receipt showed '1 mth' beside the amount paid.
entries.zh: 她的房租收据在已付金额旁写着一个月。

entries.meaningZh: 以计算机为基础的教育
entries.en: The college used CBE to let students repeat the safety lessons at their own pace.
entries.zh: 学院采用以计算机为基础的教育方式，让学生按自己的进度反复学习安全课程。
